integrity: The proof starts from the primary source's exact BML-structure condition that the modal preorder contains the scope preorder. On a finite chain this forces a total preorder whose equivalence classes are contiguous intervals. The published bounded-modal semantic clause is then reduced exactly to a suffix determined by the block minimum and classifier bound. The primary PDF was inspected at Definition 2.1 and Definition 4.1, including the bounded-modal clause; exhaustive finite replay independently checks the classification.
scientific_limitations: The result classifies only the modal-preorder component of finite BML-structures whose scope preorder is a chain. It does not classify valuations, the outer growing-domain Kripke order, or general finite partial-order scope structures, and it does not assert a validity-complexity bound.
title: Chain normal form for bounded-modal scope preorders
